plan.notes: Source: 'Technical Certificate Welding Technology' program page, 'Suggested Course Sequence - Technical Certificate Welding Technology - Manufacturing Focused Elective Choice' table, UACCB 2026-2027 College Catalog (Skilled Trades and Agriculture section). GENUINE CATALOG DISCREPANCY: sequence lists 'Shielded Metal Arc Welding | WELD 11084' vs Program Requirements 'Sheet Metal Arc Welding WELD 11084' -- kept as printed in the sequence, documented. The Welding Requirement (Gas Metal Arc Welding WELD 12084 or Pipe and Tube Welding WELD 14084, 4 credits) is resolved by the sequence to WELD 12084 Gas Metal Arc Welding in the Fall term -- printed as sequenced, documented. Program page states 27 credits (division index said 28). Printed term totals 16/11 verified against sequenced courses (sequenced sum 27 = stated credential total 27).
